name: Dalian Dalicap Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dalian Dalicap Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of radio frequency (RF) microwave ceramic capacitors in China and internationally. The company offers RF/microwave multilayer ceramic capacitors, single-layer ceramic capacitors, broadband multilayer ceramic capacitors, non-magnetic multilayer chip ceramic capacitors, non-magnetic multilayer chip resistor, thin film circuits, thick film hybrid circuits, and RF power capacitor assemblies.
